## Pull Request

**Before submitting:** Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and ensure your changes follow the [elegance bar](shared/standards.md).

### Related Issue

Closes # (issue number, if applicable)

### Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New agent
- [ ] Agent enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Infrastructure/Build change
- [ ] Other

### Description

A clear description of the changes. Explain:
- What problem this solves or feature this adds
- The approach taken
- Any trade-offs or alternatives considered

### Changes Made

- Added: 
- Modified:
- Removed:

### Testing

Describe how you tested your changes:
- [ ] Local testing with `./install.py`
- [ ] Verified agent works with `vibe --agent <agent-name>`
- [ ] Checked against [shared/standards.md](shared/standards.md)
- [ ] Added/updated tests
- [ ] Manual verification

### Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the existing style and conventions
- [ ] All new files include proper frontmatter (name, domain, tier, escalate, accepts)
- [ ] New agents are registered in `manifest.yaml`
- [ ] Documentation is updated (README, agent files, etc.)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are committed
- [ ] Changes are backward compatible (if applicable)

### Screenshots / Output

If applicable, add screenshots or example output to demonstrate the changes.
